content:
maya (product): Quick sync: finalizing GA gates for enterprise BYOK + audit evidence. Need clear acceptance criteria and pilot plan.

jin (eng-runtime): Minimal GA suggestion: tenant handshake, rotate API, per-tenant retention UI, signed evidence export, rehearsal runbook.

priya (eng-sre): Add automated reconciliation job and post-rotate smoke tests. Rehearsal must run against a pilot tenant.

carlos (security): Require signed attestations, HSM KEK support for Dedicated, and escrow docs. SOC2 needs chain-of-custody artifacts.

zoe (customer-success): Customers want dry-run, migration window, and redacted export preview. Pilot volunteers: Acme.

maya (product): Proposed gated checklist: handshake endpoints (jin), rehearsal automation (priya), retention UI (product), evidence export spec (carlos), SOC2 mapping (carlos).

jin (eng-runtime): We'll flag escrow as enterprise-only and provide fallback ephemeral keys if KMS fails. Add metrics: keystore.rotate.failure, keystore.handshake.latency, evidence.export.duration.

priya (eng-sre): Rehearsal steps: run `keystore-rehearse --tenant=acme --simulate-rotate`, validate token refresh, KV cache invalidation, export signature, and perf smoke.

carlos (security): Export must include key_id, rotation_ts, attestation_sig, requester, http_trace_id, and artifact hash. Retention configurable per contract.

zoe (customer-success): Console UX: BYOK status card, last/next rotation, export button, redacted views for non-admins. Provide CLI export for compliance teams.

maya (product): Decisions: default hosted retention=90 days, enterprise >=365 by contract, export SLA=2h. Pilot rehearsal required to enable opt-in. Gate review Mon 2024-06-17 10:30.

jin (eng-runtime): I'll open PR for API stubs and feature flag today.

priya (eng-sre): I'll draft runbook + postmortem template.

carlos (security): Drafting SOC2 mapping and sending export retention note to legal.

zoe (customer-success): Coordinating Acme for July 10 rehearsal.

maya (product): Action items: jin API (due 2024-06-30), priya runbook (due 2024-07-05), carlos SOC2 doc (due 2024-06-20), zoe pilot (due 2024-07-01), maya retention + pricing (due 2024-06-25).
